field.label: Enable Built-in DNS
field.help: Route domain resolution through Xray's own DNS server instead of the system resolver. Addresses are looked up from the DNS Servers tab (or, when disabled, from the Raw JSON: dns field in this section, shown with Show advanced fields). Domains still unmatched by any routing rule go direct.

field.label: Query Strategy
field.help: Which addresses servers are allowed to answer with: IPv4 and IPv6 (default), IPv4 only or IPv6 only.

field.label: Disable DNS Cache
field.help: Do not cache DNS answers. Useful for testing domains whose DNS changes often; costs a query per lookup in production.

field.label: Disable Fallback
field.help: If every domain-matched server fails, do not ask the untagged servers instead (strict DNS).

field.label: Disable Fallback If Match
field.help: Once a request matched a domain-tagged server, fail instead of falling back to untagged servers when it cannot answer.

field.label: Parallel Query
field.help: Query all matching servers at once and use the first answer. Higher traffic, faster answers, but can downgrade a domestic resolver's accuracy.

field.label: Use System Hosts
field.help: Feed /etc/hosts into the built-in DNS as static hosts.
